after.zh: 左图的一个点，在右图里只可能落在一条线上：这条线就是极线 l′ = F·p。匹配时只沿这条线搜，就从整张图缩成了一条线；两台相机平行时，极线正好是同一行，所以之前只在同一行里找。
after.en: A point in the left image can only land on one line in the right image: the epipolar line l′ = F·p. Searching only along it shrinks the search from a whole image to a line; when the two cameras are parallel the epipolar lines are exactly the rows, which is why the search so far stayed within one row.

t.zh: 到这里为止，两台相机都摆得很正，同一点总在同一行，只要左右找。真实的相机很难摆得这么正，稍微一转，同一点就跑到了别的行。
t.en: So far the two cameras have been set up perfectly straight, so the same point was always on the same row and you only had to search left and right. Real cameras are hard to align that well; turn one slightly and the same point moves to a different row.

t.zh: 好在两台相机的相对位置可以事先标定，记成一个 3×3 的矩阵 F，叫基础矩阵。有了它，左图的一个点在右图里不是哪里都可能出现。
t.en: Fortunately the relative position of the two cameras can be calibrated in advance and recorded as a 3×3 matrix F, the fundamental matrix. With it, a point in the left image cannot turn up just anywhere in the right one.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：算出左图一个点在右图对应的那条线 F·p，F 按列给出。
t.en: Your task in this level: work out the line F·p in the right image that corresponds to a point in the left image; F is given column by column.

desc.zh: 读 F 的三列和点 (x, y)，输出极线 F·p。
desc.en: Reads the three columns of F and a point (x, y), and outputs the epipolar line F·p.

brief.zh: 左图的点 p = (x, y, 1)。输出它在右图的极线 l′ = F·p，三个数。F 按列给出。
brief.en: A point in the left image is p = (x, y, 1). Output its epipolar line in the right image, l′ = F·p, three numbers. F is given column by column.

hint.zh: 矩阵乘一个向量，就是把矩阵的列按向量的数加权相加。
hint.en: A matrix times a vector is the matrix's columns added up, weighted by the vector's numbers.
